email.body1:
Rex, saw Trackforce launched the TrackTik Command Center and shipped Q1 2026 field-accountability updates.

Momentum like that lights up more in-market accounts than the team can act on, and the gap is usually signal-to-action latency, not effort. Our AI SDR turns signals into researched, written, sequenced outreach automatically, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Trackforce off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Rex, quick follow-up for Trackforce.

From a RevOps seat, the cost is measurable: signals surface, but by the time a rep acts the intent has cooled, and data hygiene quietly erodes the funnel. Tightening the motion alone tends to lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.

Worth 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three things I'd change to cut signal-to-action latency, with every email auto-logged to your CRM.
email.body3:
Rex, last bit of proof for Trackforce.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Trackforce's reply rate likely compares to other GTM teams scaling outbound. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
